mapper.sql: r.report_id, r.report_target_id, r.report_reason_type, r.report_status, r.report_regdate, r.report_target_type, reporter.nickname AS reporter_nickname, reported.nickname AS reported_nickname, CASE r.report_target_type WHEN 'findboard' THEN (SELECT f.find_board_title FROM tblFindBoard f WHERE f.find_board_id = r.report_target_id) WHEN 'question' THEN (SELECT q.question_board_title FROM tblQuestionBoard q WHERE q.question_board_id = r.report_target_id) WHEN 'review' THEN (SELECT re.review_board_title FROM tblReviewBoard re WHERE re.review_post_id = r.report_target_id) WHEN 'hotdeal' THEN (SELECT h.hotdeal_title FROM tblHotDealPost h WHERE h.hotdeal_id = r.report_target_id) ELSE '삭제되거나 알 수 없는 게시글' END AS post_title

SELECT
FROM tblReports r INNER JOIN tblUser reported ON r.reported_user_id = reported.user_id INNER JOIN tblUser reporter ON r.user_id = reporter.user_id
